title: luncheon corelle plates
text: luncheon corelle plates. I have this style of Corelle - obviously right?  And these lunch size plate are SO handy.  Love them.  We use them much more often than the dinner size.  Especially when my grandsons  are here.  They are tough, as Corelle usually is... and matches the other City Block Corelle pieces I have.  If you're looking for something between the dinner and roll size plate, these luncheon plates are PERFECT!  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hope this review was helpful to you!

description: Corelle Living ware Black/White Glass City Block Luncheon Plate 1 pk. City sophistication comes to your table. Black bands and squares complement this all-white, couple-shaped plate.
